Read-only comparison verifies quarantine, guarded definitions, migration contract and immutable accepted-input/export/import identities before reporting differences

Atomic deletion replay preserves original request ID, actor, fingerprint, reason and timestamp for restored workers; missing actors are disabled placeholders without credentials or sessions

Per-site immutable audit binds backup ID, ledger ID, full fingerprint and operation; exact retry performs no writes and audit failure rolls back all decision/actor/state changes
Encrypted commands retain quarantine and never copy original physical-cleanup/completion claims or authorize activation
